title: Outline closed with wheels inside the part; then an inside hole after the outline
rationale: The 600 x 750 mm part's outline is already cut through except a 30 mm bridge on its left side (prior removal). The first cut closes the bridge at C = 40; the rear and right supports stand inside the part, the left one outside. From then on the part is detached (safety-model 7.4): the wheels on it are M-ATTACH, and the hole cut inside it is T-ATTACH (a loose part is never cut).
